intent.purpose: slideshow lifestyle frame: an unplanned beach selfie on a towel
intent.scene_concept: lying on her stomach on a towel on a public beach, propped on one elbow, arm's-length front-camera selfie in hard afternoon sun
intent.place_type: busy public sand beach (not a resort pool, not a private cove)
must_stay_true: hard direct afternoon sun with sharp shadows
sand, sea horizon and other beachgoers are visible
she is lying prone on a towel, not standing or posing

subject.description: one woman resting on a beach towel, listening to music with wired earphones
subject.action: taking a selfie with her right arm while her left hand fiddles with the earphone cable under her chin
subject.pose: lying prone, torso propped on the right forearm, left elbow bent, shoulders uneven, head tilted slightly to her left
subject.expression: relaxed and a little squinty from the sun, lips slightly parted
subject.face_visibility: full face, lower half partly shaded by her hand

identity.skin: warm olive-tan skin, sun-flushed cheeks and nose, a scatter of freckles, visible pores, slight sheen of sunscreen and sweat
identity.hair: long dark-brown hair with curtain bangs, salty and clumped, wind lifting strands across the sky at frame left
identity.face: natural, bare-faced except tinted lip balm, natural asymmetry, faint squint lines

physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions, natural shoulder width
physique.detail: upper back and shoulders visible, lower body out of frame behind her

items: rust-and-cream patterned triangle bikini top with thin ties
white wired earphones with an inline remote
brown fabric scrunchie on the left wrist
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: dry swimwear with a little sand on the ties; scrunchie slightly stretched

foreground: thick white terry beach towel with sand grains and a visible fold line
background: dark blue sea horizon, slightly tilted
small distant swimmers and a family under a faded umbrella
a tote bag and a half-empty sunscreen bottle on the sand at frame right
environment.clutter: normal beach mess: sandy flip-flop, tote bag, sunscreen bottle
environment.time_of_day: mid-afternoon, clear sky with thin wispy clouds

camera.position: arm's length, slightly above her head, angled down
camera.focus: sharp on the face, everything else also reasonably sharp
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the beach behind is only slightly soft

composition.framing: head to mid-back, horizon in the upper third
composition.subject_placement: face centre-right, near shoulder large in the foreground
composition.crop: selfie arm cut off at the frame edge; one hand partly cropped at the bottom
composition.headroom: a band of bright sky above the head

sources: direct afternoon sun from above and slightly behind the camera
lighting.quality: hard: crisp shadows under the chin, under the bangs and cast by the earphone cable on the chest
lighting.exposure: bright; the towel and forehead highlights clip, the sky is slightly blown near the horizon

color.saturation: punchy sky from phone HDR, natural skin
casts: slight warm bounce from the sand on the underside of the chin

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app JPEG, uploaded to a social app
processing.hdr: Smart HDR lifting the shadows slightly and saturating the sky
processing.sharpening: default phone sharpening, a little crunchy on sand texture

imperfections: blown highlights on the towel and forehead
sand grains on the skin and towel
slight wide-angle stretch on the near shoulder

texture.skin: pores, freckles, fine arm hair, sunscreen sheen, a sand-grain or two on the forearm
texture.hair: salty clumps, flyaways, bangs separating into pieces
texture.fabric: fluffy terry loops, printed swimwear with slight fading

motion.subject: hair moving in the breeze
motion.blur: slight motion blur on the windblown strands only

anatomy: exactly two arms: the right arm holds the phone out of frame, the left hand is under the chin
five fingers on the visible hand, natural nails
the propped torso rests believably on the forearm
physics: the earphone cable hangs under gravity and casts a shadow
hair blows in one consistent wind direction
the horizon is one straight line
geometry.perspective: front-camera wide perspective, near shoulder slightly enlarged, no fisheye

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

typography.scene_text: the sunscreen bottle label is small and only partly legible

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: a real-looking sunscreen label and tote print are fine; do not invent new readable text
brands: an ordinary drugstore sunscreen brand on the bottle

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no posed swimwear-shoot look, no model pose
no golden-hour glow or soft beauty light
no bokeh background or cinematic grade
no text overlays, UI or watermarks
